body:
Independent adversarial review of the round67 publication closeout helper found a narrow receipt-binding gap. The prepared final PR comment claimed fixed validation counts and topic-commit absence in both isolated checks, while the helper did not directly verify those counts, load the preflight receipt, or check the topic-absence observations. Earlier publication gates already enforced these invariants; the gap was in the final reporting step, not a demonstrated scientific-record defect or unsafe merge.

The affected session helper is `/private/tmp/cmm-round67-closeout.py`. Save the initial and successor operational review artifacts in the round67 publication bundle so the exact reviewed helper hashes and correction are reviewable after the temporary session.

Acceptance:

- Bind both successful isolated receipts to the reviewed topic head, tree, trusted base, mode and actual merge where applicable.
- Verify their log hashes, successful required commands, expected counts and three explicit topic-object absence observations; check the actual postmerge test result before reporting it.
- Require completed owned-branch cleanup and a clean detached worktree, alongside successful hosted checks and preserved original main.
- Independently re-review the corrected helper and save the disposition; retain the initial finding.
- Publish only after the real receipts pass, then verify the posted comment matches its prepared body. Do not close scientific source gaps as part of this correction.

This issue concerns the authorized round67 publication process. It does not call for a schema, validator, governed-workflow change or a fabricated scientific correction.
title: Bind round67 publication closeout claims to completed verification receipts
